script.es: Tu idea, convertida en una pieza que llevaras siempre.
script.en: Your idea, turned into a piece you will wear forever.

parrafo.es: Un estudio de tatuajes en Jacksonville con artistas para cada estilo: floral, black and grey, color y fine line. Casi 500 reseñas en Google lo respaldan.
parrafo.en: A tattoo studio in Jacksonville with artists for every style: floral, black and grey, color and fine line. Almost 500 Google reviews back it up.

hero.imagen_alt: Color tattoo of a red Japanese dragon with peonies on a forearm, by Divine Lines Tattoo

parrafo_1.es: Divine Lines Tattoo es un estudio de tatuajes en Jacksonville con varios artistas residentes, cada uno con su propio estilo: floral y black and grey detallado, retratos y piezas de color, y fine line delicado.
parrafo_1.en: Divine Lines Tattoo is a Jacksonville studio with several resident artists, each with their own style: detailed floral and black and grey, portrait and color work, and delicate fine line.

parrafo_2.es: Reseña tras reseña dicen lo mismo: artistas talentosos que escuchan tu idea y la hacen mejor de lo que imaginabas. Leandria reservo con Zo para una pieza en la mano y el antebrazo, y salio con una obra maestra en la piel.
parrafo_2.en: Review after review says the same thing: talented artists who listen to your idea and make it better than you imagined. Leandria booked with Zo for a hand and forearm piece and walked out with a masterpiece on her skin.

texto.es: Mangas y piezas de pierna completas en varias sesiones.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu idea? Llama igual, seguro hay un artista para ella.
pie.en: Do not see your idea listed? Call anyway, there is likely an artist for it.

items.quote: I love this shop, all of the artists are so talented and nice! They are always willing to work with you to make sure you get exactly what you are looking for out of your tattoo!! I have gotten many pieces by many artists and will continue to get my tattoos here!

Had a simple idea for an hand/forearm tattoo and booked with Zo. I came out with a masterpiece on my skin! Zotatsyu has great communication and shared his vision with me on the tattoo I wanted and made it better than I could have imagined...
I adore this shop and the artists there feel like family. The art is stellar, not a single slack artist in the building...
